highest_immediate_unlock_surfaces.reason: The mapping appears structurally simple and official ST product data identifies representative B/T parts as LQFP208, but current representative commercial parts across STM32F429/439/469/479 are NRND. Policy-ready count alone would therefore overstate near-term exact-ICPN admission value.
High theoretical unlock, but broader BGA package evidence and lifecycle review are required before preferring it over a smaller Active-only surface.

selected_next_surface.reason: All three O/Y gaps have no residual blocker. Package code Y is already defined as WLCSP in the STM32F4 admission policy. Current official ST product data exposes Active exact parts for STM32F405OE, STM32F405OG, and STM32F415OG and identifies the Y package as WLCSP90. This gives a one-line bounded pin/package policy extension with immediate downstream admission value and no new package-code or flash-size semantics.
